questions.text: An accessible ramp is longer than 10.50 m. Under the cited BP 344 2024 IRR excerpt, what intermediate landing length must be provided?

rationale.correct: The source states that accessible ramps with total length longer than 10.50 m shall have intermediate landings with a minimum length of 1800 mm.

distractors.A: 900 mm is linked to handrail height, not landing length.
distractors.B: 1200 mm is the minimum clear ramp width.
distractors.C: 1500 mm is not the cited landing length for this condition.

rationale.takeaway: If the ramp length exceeds 10.50 m, pair the trigger with the 1800 mm landing.
